body: Oh wow. Are there cases where we might need the specific behavior of localeCompare? (sorting strings based on locale)

Is it the same as?

``` js
return '`' + props.join('`, `') + '`';
```

Probably less readable :)

Yep, it is, although ESLint would want us to do

``` js
return `\`${props.join('`, `')}\``;
```

Although it's a bit longer, I prefer the map/join version, it has clearer intent imho.
